repos.description: A theoretical reconstruction of the Claude Mythos architecture, built from first principles using the available research literature.
repos.blurb: OpenMythos is a theoretical reconstruction of Claude's Mythos architecture implemented as a Recurrent-Depth Transformer (RDT) that loops a subset of transformer layers multiple times per forward pass. The implementation uses input injection at each loop iteration to prevent hidden state drift and includes switchable attention mechanisms (MLA/GQA) with sparse MoE layers.

It specializes in AI/Agent system architectures with built-in knowledge of patterns like RAG, multi-agent flows, and memory architectures, supporting 8 diagram types across 5 visual styles. The tool uses semantic shape vocabulary (hexagons for agents, cylinders for databases) and color-coded arrows to automatically convey technical relationships.

repos.description: Instant, Concurrent, Secure & Lightweight Sandbox for AI Agents.
Curated list of Agent Skills centered on people, relationships, commemorative scenes, and methodological perspectives
repos.blurb: A curated collection of "persona distillation" skills that extract communication styles, decision frameworks, and behavioral patterns from chat logs, documents, and digital traces of various personas including colleagues, mentors, public figures, and personal relationships. Users can create AI agents that mimic specific individuals' interaction styles for purposes like memory preservation, communication training, or applying notable figures' methodologies to their own work. The project emphasizes that persona distillation extracts interaction patterns rather than attempting complete personality replication of real individuals.

repos.description: Claude + Obsidian knowledge companion. Persistent, compounding wiki vault based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. /wiki /save /autoresearch
repos.blurb: This is a Claude-powered plugin that automatically builds and maintains an Obsidian knowledge vault by ingesting sources, extracting entities and concepts, and creating cross-references without manual organization. It enables persistent knowledge accumulation where every added source gets integrated and every question pulls from the entire accumulated knowledge base with specific page citations. The system implements Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern with autonomous features like contradiction detection, vault maintenance, and multi-round web research.

repos.description: Free, open-source macOS cleaner. CleanMyMac alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI, scheduled auto-cleaning, Xcode/Homebrew/system cache cleanup. MIT licensed.
repos.blurb: PureMac is a free, open-source macOS disk cleaner built with SwiftUI that serves as a privacy-focused alternative to CleanMyMac. It removes system caches, Xcode/Homebrew artifacts, large files, and other disk clutter with scheduled auto-cleaning capabilities, while operating entirely offline with zero telemetry. The app is signed and notarized by Apple, eliminating Gatekeeper security warnings during installation.

repos.description: Hermes Agent 从入门到精通 · 橙皮书系列 · Nous Research 开源 AI Agent 框架实战指南
repos.blurb: This is a comprehensive guide book for Hermes Agent, an open-source AI Agent framework by Nous Research. It provides practical tutorials covering the framework's core mechanisms (learning loops, memory systems, skill creation) and real-world implementation scenarios for developers wanting to build AI agents. The guide is available as a free PDF download in both Chinese and English, structured as 17 chapters across 5 parts from basic concepts to advanced multi-agent scenarios.
